report.how: Depth slots match only through the held NFL identity crosswalk. Points per game uses finished weeks with a held score, including zero. Season points sum the same held finished-week scores used by the card; an unfinished week is excluded. Missing facts are not predictions. Posted times are estimated from MFL’s elapsed wording at the fetch time, in your local time zone. Minutes show a minute, hours show about an hour, and days show only a date. Unrecognized wording or a missing fetch time has no posted time.
